## Definitions

- [statement] Fee-free status is a per-market setting that Lighter has changed before. All RWA perp markets traded with 0 fees across every fee and staking tier in March 2026, and in April 2026 RWA market fees turned back on, applied based on tier. In April 2026 Lighter added is_taker_fee_enabled and is_maker_fee_enabled fields to the orderBookDetails endpoint so clients can verify markets where fees are disabled, and said only $LIT had maker fees set to zero. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-04-18) — https://t.me/lighter_api_updates/104 · keywords: Zero-fee perpetual futures venues with API access · also: https://t.me/lighter_api_updates/121, https://t.me/lighter_api_updates/122
- [statement] A Lighter API key is a keypair separate from the Ethereum key. Each key is bound to one account index (master, sub-account or pool) and has its own nonce stream. Usable key indexes are 4 to 254. Indexes 0–3 are reserved for Lighter's apps (on Robinhood Chain, 157 is also reserved), and 255 is only for querying all keys. Registering a key uses ChangePubKey, which always needs an L1 wallet signature (or an on-chain call). (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-22) — https://docs.lighter.xyz/developers/integration-guides/api-keys.md · keywords: Zero-fee perpetual futures venues with API access · also: https://docs.lighter.xyz/developers/getting-started/core-concepts.md, https://docs.lighter.xyz/developers/reference/wasm-signer.md
- [statement] Variational's documented public API is a market-statistics REST endpoint (GET /metadata/v2/stats, 10 requests per 10 seconds per IP). An unofficial, reverse-engineered TypeScript client on GitHub says Variational publishes no trading API and no API keys, and warns its API can change without notice. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-22) — https://docs.variational.io/technical-documentation/api · keywords: Zero-fee perpetual futures venues with API access · also: https://github.com/Magicianhax/variational-trading-api/blob/main/README.md
- [statement] Variational's documented public API is a market-statistics endpoint, GET /metadata/v2/stats, limited to 10 requests per 10 seconds per IP and 1000 requests per minute globally, with HTTP 429 and a retry_after_seconds field on excess. An unofficial, reverse-engineered TypeScript client states that Variational publishes no trading API and no API keys. Its docs roadmap lists 'Enable API trading', a November 2026 Business Wire press release says its roadmap for the remainder of 2026 includes launching a trading API, and Bankless reported that on Nov. 4th the API would go to a small group of alpha testers ahead of a public launch this month. ## Structure and components

- [statement] Across MEXC, Phemex and BingX, zero-fee futures headlines come with API carve-outs. MEXC's Jun 1, 2026 notice sets an API schedule of 0.06% maker and 0.08% taker, and says API trading is subject to a separate fee structure that takes precedence over promotional offers such as 0-fee events. The Phemex carnival terms exclude API trading, and BingX's TradFi promotion excludes API trading. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-17) — https://www.mexc.com/announcements/article/updates-to-api-futures-trading-fees-jun-1-2026-17827791535742 · keywords: Zero-fee perpetual futures venues with API access · also: https://phemex.com/blogs/tradfi-futures-zero-fee-carnival, https://bingx.com/en/support/articles/18416986883343/
- [statement] MEXC's API futures fee notices say API trades follow a separate fee structure that takes precedence over web and app rates and over promotional offers such as 0-fee events and MX discounts. MEXC's own example: BTCUSDT futures cost maker 0% and taker 0.01% on the web or app, but trades executed via API are charged the API rate. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-05-28) — https://www.mexc.com/announcements/article/updates-to-api-futures-trading-fees-jun-1-2026-17827791535742 · keywords: Zero-fee perpetual futures venues with API access · also: https://www.mexc.com/announcements/article/updates-to-api-futures-trading-fees-may-1-2026-17827791535194, https://www.mexc.com/announcements/article/introducing-api-futures-trading-on-mar-31-2026-17827791534551
- [statement] Gate's USDT-M TradFi Perpetuals have a dedicated fee structure effective September 1, 2026. VIP 0 pays 0.0200% maker and 0.0500% taker, and the maker fee is 0.0000% only at VIP 14, VIP 15 and VIP 16, with taker 0.0180%, 0.0150% and 0.0120%. Market-maker tiers pay 0.000% (MM 0) and -0.003%, -0.004% and -0.005% (MM 1 to MM 3). Gate's USDT-M Perpetual Futures Taker Program commences on September 1, 2026, with discounts of 9%, 16% and 20% for monthly taker volume shares of 0.02% ≤ X < 0.2%, 0.2% ≤ X < 1% and X ≥ 1%; participants contact their Account Manager to register. Gate's fee page says users whose API trading volume accounts for at least 60%, or who have reached VIP tier 15 or 16, will be automatically upgraded to advanced institutional users. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-08-26) — https://www.gate.com/announcements/article/101365 · keywords: Zero-fee perpetual futures venues with API access · also: https://www.gate.com/fee
- [statement] MEXC opened futures trading to the API on Mar 31, 2026, 06:00 (UTC) for users who completed KYC verification, on all futures pairs except Innovation Zone pairs, at 0.01% maker and 0.05% taker. It then raised the API schedule twice: to 0.04% maker and 0.06% taker effective May 1, 2026, at 08:00 (UTC) (notice listed Apr 30, 2026), and to 0.06% maker and 0.08% taker effective Jun 1, 2026, at 08:00 (UTC) (notice listed May 28, 2026). The notices say API trading follows a separate fee structure that takes precedence over web and app rates and promotions such as 0-fee events and MX discounts. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-22) — https://www.mexc.com/announcements/article/introducing-api-futures-trading-on-mar-31-2026-17827791534551 · keywords: Zero-fee perpetual futures venues with API access · also: https://www.mexc.com/announcements/article/updates-to-api-futures-trading-fees-jun-1-2026-17827791535742, https://www.mexc.com/fr/announcements/api-updates
- [statement] Variational Omni charges no trading fees: its docs say 'There are no trading fees on Omni', plus a flat $0.1 fee per deposit/withdraw and liquidations at ask price + 0.5% (short) or bid price - 0.5% (long); Omni generates revenue by capturing the spread, and the Variational Protocol receives a cut of that spread revenue. A Business Wire press release says the OLP structure 'allows Omni to charge no trading fees', and CoinGecko ('Zero trading fees') and CoinLaunch ('0% trading fees') also list zero trading fees. CoinGecko's Variational section is marked as brought to you by Variational, so it is not independent. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-22) — https://docs.variational.io/omni/trading/fees · keywords: Zero-fee perpetual futures venues with API access · also: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261116481769/en/Variational-Raises-%24110M-Series-B-at-%241.5B-Valuation-To-Scale-On-Chain-Access-To-Global-Markets, https://www.coingecko.com/learn/best-perp-dexes-and-on-chain-trading-platforms, https://coinlaunch.space/blog/perp-dex-list-best-perpetual-trading-platforms/

- [statement] In a November 2026 announcement Lighter said new per-IP WebSocket limits take effect on Lighter Core after the scheduled downtime on Sunday, November 22. Standard / public, Plus and base Premium get 50 connections, 1,000 subscriptions, 200 unique accounts and 200 client messages per 60 seconds. Premium 1 and above get 255 connections, 5,000 subscriptions, 5,000 unique accounts and 1,000 client messages per 60 seconds; Builder gets 255, 10,000, 10,000 and 10,000. Only connections authenticated with the Authorization handshake header receive tier limits, while Plus and base Premium retain Standard limits even when authenticated. The rate-limits docs page still listed the older limits of 255 connections and 5000 subscriptions per IP. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-22) — https://t.me/lighter_api_updates/203 · keywords: Zero-fee perpetual futures venues with API access · also: https://docs.lighter.xyz/developers/reference/rate-limits, https://github.com/elliottech/lighter-python/releases/tag/v1.1.9
- [statement] On the morning of November 16 (UTC) an attacker recovered API private keys from public signatures because the affected accounts used unsafe signing code other than the official Lighter SDKs that reused signing nonces, then moved funds through a public pool: create a public pool from the affected account, mint pool shares in a separate attacker-controlled account, transfer the affected account's funds into the pool (increasing NAV without minting pool shares), redeem the shares and withdraw. Lighter says its protocol, smart contracts and infrastructure were not affected. Bitquery traced one withdrawal of 10,393,057 USDC at 10:11 UTC to a single wallet that swapped it to ETH in four minutes and sent 1,920 ETH through twelve new wallets to Hyperliquid, where each one bought XMR1. (high confidence) — https://x.com/Lighter_xyz/article/2122394446343946717 · keywords: Zero-fee perpetual futures venues with API access · also: https://x.com/GoPlusSecurity/status/2122520900046319815, https://bitquery.io/investigations/lighter-hack, https://www.coindesk.com/tech/2026/11/16/lighter-suspends-all-withdrawals-after-usd10-4-million-crypto-exploit, https://cryptobriefing.com/lighter-api-key-security-exploit/
- [statement] lighter-go v1.0.13 retracts v1.0.1 because GenerateAPIKey with a non-empty seed produced weak, predictable API keys, and tells users to upgrade and rotate any API key generated with a seed. The same release bumps golang.org/x/crypto for a critical vulnerability and requires Go 1.26. (low confidence) — https://github.com/elliottech/lighter-go/releases/tag/v1.0.13

## How-to and procedures

- [statement] To audit which lane a fill got, read the `flags` array on fills from List Fills: `fastfill` marks a fill that qualified for the FastFills discount of 30%. The discounted fee amount is in the fill's `fee` field. ## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] Thin perps are fragile. On November 16 the ASTER token fell by roughly 32% (from about $0.71 to about $0.48), with about $9.16 million of liquidations, 65% of them longs, per CoinGlass data cited by CryptoPotato. Aster's CEO confirmed an internal investigation and denied any market-maker arrangement; the trader theory of a perp-market distortion spilling into spot prices remains unconfirmed. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-16) — https://www.kcex.com/news/148260
- [statement] Binance's fee page lists a regular user at 0.0200%/0.0500% on USDT-margined contracts, with the USDC/USD1 column showing 0.0000%/0.0400% alongside 0.0200%/0.0500%. The 0.0000% USDT maker rate appears only at VIP 9 (at least 25,000,000,000 USD of trade volume and 5,500 BNB), where the USDT taker rate is 0.0170%. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-22) — https://www.binance.com/en/fee/futureFee

Users who reach a total Binance Futures trading volume of 100,000,000 USDT equivalent in the last 30 days may apply and are assessed in the Program's weekly review. A limited-time promotion effective from 2026-11-10 06:00 (UTC) until 2027-01-03 23:59 (UTC) increases the taker fee discounts for Tier 2 and Tier 3 from 14% to 15% and from 18% to 20%. Users are removed from the Taker Program if they do not meet the minimum criteria for three consecutive weeks, and can reapply after 3 months upon removal. ## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Aster's AOS-2 docs describe an application route to a perp listing: stake 200,000 ASTER locked for 4 years (returned on rejection), hold a token listed on Binance Alpha or a Tier 2 exchange with at least $10,000,000 circulating market cap, name a designated market-maker wallet already connected to Aster, pass an on-chain validator vote, then Aster's Risk team configures leverage brackets and open interest caps and the market goes live T+1 at 3× initial leverage. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-22) — https://docs.asterdex.com/aster-open-standards/aos-2-perpetual-listing · keywords: Zero-fee perpetual futures venues with API access · also: https://finance.biggo.com/news/aab2ce3f-6278-4c28-8785-9d81254b43b9
- [statement] MEXC's web/app zero-fee futures program grants 0-fee eligibility automatically after regular system evaluations, based on factors such as account status, trading activity, effective trading volume, risk review and market conditions. Certain pairs have a maximum trading volume that is eligible for 0 fees. MEXC's own pages quote different pair counts: an article verified August 19, 2026 says 320+ perpetuals at 0% on both sides, while the 0 Fee Fest FAQ text says 100+ Futures pairs. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-08-19) — https://www.mexc.com/zero-fee · keywords: Zero-fee perpetual futures venues with API access · also: https://www.mexc.com/learn/article/best-zero-fee-crypto-exchanges-2026-we-checked-8-fee-schedules-only-one-is-zero-on-every-line-/1
- [statement] MEXC's official Futures API provides REST API and WebSocket streaming services. Order placement is POST /api/v1/private/order/create with the required permission Order Placing. Order type 2 is Post Only (maker only), alongside limit, IOC, FOK and market types, and stpMode sets the self-trade prevention mode. Accounts that have not completed KYC can still create an API key but may not be able to enable or use futures order placement–related permissions. API Keys that are not bound to IP addresses are valid for 90 days. Signing uses the HMAC-SHA256 algorithm with a Request-Time header, and a request is invalid if req_time is more than 10 seconds (default) behind or ahead of the server time. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-22) — https://www.mexc.com/api-docs/futures/integration-guide · keywords: Zero-fee perpetual futures venues with API access · also: https://www.mexc.com/api-docs/futures/account-and-trading-endpoints/place-order
- [statement] Bybit's Aug 10, 2026 announcement says its discount covers 170+ TradFi Perpetual Contract symbols, with availability until further notice, for all TradFi Perpetual Contract symbols (excluding Pre-IPO symbols). The discounted maker rate is 0% against a standard ~0.0200%, and the discounted taker rate is ~0.0275% (varies by VIP level) against ~0.0550%. Bybit's futures fee page has a column labelled TradFi Perps 50% off: a Regular User shows maker 0% and taker 0.0275%, and Supreme VIP also shows a 0% maker rate. TokenPost reports that ANTAUSDT, GLXYUSDT and TMOUSDT were scheduled to start trading on Tuesday, Nov. 17, with a launch promotion that sets fees at zero on limit orders and cuts market-order fees by 50%. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-22) — https://announcements.bybit.com/en/article/trade-tradfi-perpetual-contracts-with-discounted-fees--artb2fe3d16ab53/ · keywords: Zero-fee perpetual futures venues with API access · also: https://www.bybit.com/en/fee/futures, https://www.tokenpost.com/news/business/59345
- [statement] Bitfinex's POST /v2/auth/r/summary documentation lists a FEE_INFO array ("Array with info on your current fee rates") whose maker part includes DERIV_REBATE ("Shows the maker rebate for derivative trades on the account") and whose taker part includes DERIV_TAKER_FEE ("Shows the taker fee rate for derivative trades on the account"), plus a TRADING_VOL_AND_FEE array ("Array with data on your trading volume and fees paid"). The documented rate limit is 90 req/min, and the page shows "Updatedover 1 year ago". The Bitfinex Q&A also tells users to review trade history to confirm that fees are set to zero. (medium confidence) — https://docs.bitfinex.com/reference/rest-auth-summary · keywords: Zero-fee perpetual futures venues with API access · also: https://blog.bitfinex.com/products/zero-fees-qa/

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Listing counts increasingly reflect RWA rather than altcoins. one RWA-perps guide's timeline says that on 11 September 2026 perpetual DEXs passed 1,000 listed RWA markets, 747 of them individual shares; Castle Labs reports RWA perps reached $147.5 billion of volume in July 2026, 19.6% of all onchain perp volume; and CoinGecko, citing DefiLlama data, says Variational grew from 6 to over 119 TradFi markets between May and September. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-19) — https://www.bit.com/knowledge-hub/rwa-perps · keywords: Zero-fee perpetual futures venues with API access · also: https://castlelabs.io/research/reports/mapping-the-perpetual-trading-ecosystem, https://www.coingecko.com/learn/best-perp-dexes-and-on-chain-trading-platforms
- [statement] MEXC's own comparison article gives a cost example: a spot strategy turning over $500,000 a month with an 80% maker share costs $600 in total fees a year on MEXC's standard spot schedule, versus $240 in maker fees plus $80 in taker fees a month, or $3,840 a year, if routed through the MEXC futures API at the June 2026 schedule. The example is a vendor illustration. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-08-03) — https://www.mexc.com/learn/article/crypto-trading-api-comparison-2026-rate-limits-sandboxes-and-the-fees-your-code-actually-pays/1
- [statement] Binance's 2026-11-04 notice says the TradFi Perps promotion announced on 2026-03-31 continues on its original terms, with a Promotion Period of 2026-03-31 02:00 (UTC) until further notice. Regular to VIP 3 users continue to receive a 20% discount on taker fees and VIP 4 to 9 users a 50% discount, compared to the standard USDT taker fee rate. Its table lists 0.0000% maker for Regular User and VIP 1 to VIP 9; taker is 0.0400% (0.0360% with the 10% BNB discount) for Regular User and VIP 1, and 0.0085% (0.0077%) for VIP 9. On 2026-10-28 Binance announced the VIP 4 to 9 discount would be reduced from 50% to 40% with effect from 2026-11-05 08:00 (UTC); the 2026-11-04 notice says that change will not be implemented. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-04) — https://www.binance.com/en/support/announcement/detail/e3424d3a781841eb8b507bc694c0ca3a · keywords: Zero-fee perpetual futures venues with API access · also: https://www.binance.com/en/support/announcement/detail/4f406308840549ffb8fdaac9873c25a8
- [statement] Binance's 2026-07-02 notice introduces a fee discount promotion for U (United Stables)-margined perpetual contracts, starting with BTCU and ETHU. All regular to VIP 9 users enjoy 0 maker fees during the Promotion Period, which runs from 2026-07-02 10:00 (UTC) until further notice. Regular to VIP 3 users receive a 20% discount on taker fees and VIP 4 to 9 users a 50% discount, compared to the standard USDT taker fee rate; the table lists 0.0400% taker for a regular user, 0.0150% for VIP 4 and 0.0085% for VIP 9. Binance's fee page repeats that all regular and VIP 1 to 9 users get 0 maker fee and up to 50% discounts on taker fees when trading any U (United Stable)- Margined Perps during the Promotion Period. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-07-02) — https://www.binance.com/en/support/announcement/detail/2d6508a405454beb8ebbb9e0f1a695fe · keywords: Zero-fee perpetual futures venues with API access · also: https://www.binance.com/en/fee/futureFee
- [statement] Bitfinex's announcement of Wednesday, December 17, 2025 says fees for all maker and taker activity on Bitfinex platforms will no longer be charged, effective immediately, with zero fees applying to products including derivatives trading. Its fee schedule lists derivatives trades with maker fees Zero and taker fees Zero. The Zero Fees Q&A says this is not a short term promotion, that there is no fixed end date, and that zero maker and taker fees apply to all trading pairs within the eligible product categories. Forbes says the announcement positions this as a long-term strategy rather than promotional activity, and Coinspeaker (via Yahoo Finance) says the change has no defined date to end. ## Facts and statements

- [statement] Hyperliquid's long-tail growth runs through HIP-3: a deployer meeting the staking requirement of 500k HYPE (maintained for a minimum of 183 days after the dex is deployed) can deploy one perp dex with independent margining, order books and deployer settings. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-22) — https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/hyperliquid-improvement-proposals-hips/hip-3-builder-deployed-perpetuals · keywords: Zero-fee perpetual futures venues with API access · also: https://crypto.news/hyperliquid-hip-3-and-hip-4-explained/, https://www.talos.com/insights/state-of-the-network-368
- [statement] Hyperliquid's HIP-3 requires a deployer to hold 500k HYPE staked (maintained for a minimum of 183 days after the dex is deployed) to deploy one perp dex with independent margining and order books. The first 3 assets deployed in any perp dex need no auction participation; additional assets go through a Dutch auction. A deployer can settle an asset with the `haltTrading` action at the current mark price and reuse it, and once all assets are settled the required stake is free to be unstaked. Validators can slash a deployer's stake for malicious market operation. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-22) — https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/hyperliquid-improvement-proposals-hips/hip-3-builder-deployed-perpetuals · keywords: Zero-fee perpetual futures venues with API access · also: https://coinpaprika.com/education/perp-dex, https://castlelabs.io/research/reports/mapping-the-perpetual-trading-ecosystem
- [statement] Lighter's announcements feed shows plain 'New Perp Listing' headings (including $BE, $AVGO and $GME) next to 'New RWA Perp Listings', and delistings of $FOGO, $EDEN, $DOLO, $RESOLV and $MYX (September 22) and $PROVE and $EDGE (October 28), with open perp positions settled at the mark price. Pyth describes Lighter as expanding perpetual markets beyond crypto into equities and other real-world assets. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-22) — https://app.lighter.xyz/announcements · keywords: Zero-fee perpetual futures venues with API access · also: https://mainnet.zklighter.elliot.ai/api/v1/orderBookDetails, https://www.pyth.network/blog/lighter-explores-pyth-indices-as-it-expands-perpetual-markets-beyond-crypto
- [statement] MEXC's own 0-Fee Fest page states that institutional accounts, market makers, project teams and API users are not eligible for 0 fees. The MEXC 'best zero-fee exchanges' article repeats that MEXC's event terms exclude API users, institutions and market makers from zero-fee promotions. The headline zero-fee futures rate therefore does not describe an API strategy on MEXC. The announcement says the zero-fee promotion applies exclusively to TradFi Perpetual Futures, and that other futures trading, spot trading, and API trading are excluded.
